shadows.name: soft-neutral
shadows.purpose: Reserved for elements that visually float or lift on interaction; static cards use a 1px border instead.

shadows.name: hero-blue
shadows.purpose: The one gradient hero per surface (home weather card, story card).

motion.name: sheen-sweep
motion.value: diagonal light sweep, linear easing, ~3.2s loop
motion.purpose: Holo-tier card motion signature, unchanged from prior generations.

motion.name: mascot-bob
motion.purpose: Idle mascot animation, now at avatar scale rather than hero scale.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid ink-black pill, the reference's Email/GitHub button language.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #1C1C1E; color: #ffffff; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; padding: 15px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; transition: opacity 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3E6DAE; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: 0.85; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: White active pill with soft shadow on a card-alt track — the reference's language-toggle pattern.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: flex; background: #EAE9E5; border-radius: 11px; padding: 3px; } .ds-segment { flex: 1; border: none; background: transparent; color: #75747A; font-weight: 600; font-size: 12.5px; padding: 8px 0; border-radius: 9px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-segment--active { background: #ffffff; color: #1C1C1E; box-shadow: 0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); } .ds-segment:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3E6DAE; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Dex Card
components.description: 1.5px finish-tier outline; rarity shown as a swatch dot beside neutral-gray type, not colored text.
components.css: .ds-dex-card { width: 160px; background: #ffffff; border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden; border: 1.5px solid #7558B0; } .ds-dex-card__art { position: relative; height: 88px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 30px; opacity: 0.7; background: #DCE8F7; } .ds-dex-card__obs { position: absolute; top: 7px; right: 7px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); border-radius: 6px; padding: 2px 6px; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; color: #1C1C1E; } .ds-dex-card__body { padding: 10px; } .ds-dex-card__name { font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; color: #1C1C1E; } .ds-dex-card__meta { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 4px; font-size: 10px; color: #8B897F; } .ds-dex-card__dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: #7558B0; margin-right: 4px; display: inline-block; }

components.name: Tab Bar
components.description: Frosted glass bar with an active-tab background pill and a solitary blue camera FAB — lifted directly from the reference's mobile nav.
components.css: .ds-tabbar { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-around; height: 72px; padding-top: 8px; background: rgba(247,246,244,0.92); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); border-top: 1px solid #E1DFDA; } .ds-tab { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 3px; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 12px; background: none; border: none; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; color: #8B897F; } .ds-tab--active { background: rgba(28,28,30,0.055); color: #1C1C1E; } .ds-fab { width: 52px; height: 52px; margin-top: -22px; border-radius: 26px; background: #3E6DAE; color: #fff; font-size: 22px; box-shadow: 0 5px 12px rgba(62,109,174,0.35); }

narrative.overview:
mongle's second visual generation trades the original's soft pastel-glow-everywhere language for the restraint of a well-made personal site: a warm neutral canvas, one blue point color doing all the interactive work, black pill buttons for primary actions, and small flat color swatches carrying category meaning instead of saturated gradients. It is directly informed by a real reference (github.com/1eehvunzin/personalweb) — its actual visual language and its own mobile-breakpoint patterns (bottom sheet with a grabber handle, active-tab background pill) were adopted directly, since mongle already is the native context those patterns describe.

The mascot and the collecting mechanic survive as product truth, but the mascot's role shrank from hero-scale to avatar-scale, consistent with the reference's restraint.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral warm-gray canvas, white cards, one blue point accent — restraint over saturation
Black ink pill buttons for every primary action; blue reserved for links, active states, and the one camera FAB
Rarity/category meaning carried by small flat swatches/dots beside neutral text, never by colored text
Soft neutral (never colored) drop shadows, low opacity
Two-column stat blocks and row/timeline lists borrowed from the reference's information layout
Exactly one gradient moment per surface

rules.name: The Core Triad Rule
rules.body: Ink black, sky blue, and white are the system's defining combination, confirmed directly by the user. Every screen's dominant surfaces should read as this triad first; rarity/category hues are minor accents on top, never a fourth co-equal color.

rules.name: The Swatch, Not Text Rule
rules.body: Rarity and category color never colors text directly — it lives in a small solid dot or square beside neutral-colored text.

rules.name: The One Gradient Rule
rules.body: Each surface gets at most one gradient moment. Everywhere else is flat.

rules.name: The Border-Over-Shadow Rule
rules.body: A static card gets a 1px border hairline, not a shadow. Shadow is reserved for elements that visually float or lift on interaction.

dos: Do treat ink black / sky blue / white as the confirmed core triad for every screen's dominant surfaces.
Do use blue exclusively for interactive elements.
Do give every primary action the same black pill button.
Do default to a 1px border for static cards; reserve shadow for elements that lift.
Do keep the mascot present but avatar-scale, not hero-scale.
donts: Don't color body text with a rarity/category hue directly.
Don't introduce a second gradient moment on a screen that already has one.
Don't revert to the old hue-tinted glow shadow system.
